people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
translations.bsb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
translations.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
translations.asv: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.
